office_does: The county treasurer collects property taxes and safeguards and accounts for county funds.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Treasurer Kayla Meise (prefers Republican), unopposed in 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Adams County Treasurer with 19 years in banking, auditing and government treasury work; the only candidate.
